decision: Selected the area centroid of the AU2Ee zone of the PLUi de la Porte du Hainaut in Escaudain, the zone of the site 'Les Soufflantes' (former Usinor brownfield) that the intercommunal modification no. 3 proposes to open as a digital-economy zone for a national data-centre project, as the campus locator replacing the imported Escaudain locality point.
layer: Geoportail de l'urbanisme zone-urba features intersecting the box 3.30-3.39 E, 50.30-50.35 N (partition DU_200042190, document 200042190_PLUI_20260910) served by the IGN API Carto in WGS84; the single 'AU2Ee' feature (gid 4775017, regulation file psr-10) lies wholly inside the GPU commune outline of Escaudain (INSEE 59205); projected to Lambert-93 (EPSG:2154) with pyproj 3.7.1, area centroid taken and transformed back to WGS84
